experiment.label_source_note: Synthetic injection only (positive=depth>0 [75,150,225,300 ppm], negative=depth=0). Not real-planet labels.
experiment.split_strategy: Segment-level split by parent continuous segment (gap >1d split); no overlap between train/val/test.

results.label_source_note: Synthetic injection only (positive=depth>0 [75,150,225,300 ppm], negative=depth=0). Not real-planet labels.
results.split_strategy: Segment-level split by parent continuous segment (gap >1d split); no overlap between train/val/test.
results.synthetic_only_warning: Performance measured on simulated windows only. Generalization to real observations remains unverified.

features.depth_rel_ppm: median - min of normalized flux (approximate depth indicator)
features.mad_scatter: median absolute deviation from median (robust scatter)
features.gap_fraction: fraction of cadences with gap > 0.05 d
features.matched_filter_corr: correlation with batman template (150 ppm depth) at published ephemeris
features.segment_std_ppm: standard deviation of flux within window (includes variability from parent segment)

feature_config.segment_metadata_feature: segment_std_ppm captures parent-continuous-segment variability (from phase4_residual_diagnostics); it serves as the requested segment-level feature.
feature_config.split_method: segment-level split (same segment ID never appears in both train/test); verified in test_phase5_leakage

scientific_notice: This experiment uses synthetic transit injections. Performance on simulated windows does not establish generalization to real observations and is not evidence of a new exoplanet discovery.
